name: ci-memory
description: Investigate CI failures, verify fixes, and reuse team knowledge.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@ci-memory/runner && npm run dev --workspace=@ci-memory/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ci-memory/runner && npm run build --workspace=@ci-memory/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@ci-memory/runner && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:check: npm run build && npm run db:check --workspace=@ci-memory/api
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
